jobs_results.title: Junior php developer (laravel)
jobs_results.description:
Tu nueva empresa

Compañía líder, reconocida e internacional de servicios médicos.
con sede central en Alemania, presente en más de 40 países en 4 continentes y con más de 22.000 empleados

Tu nuevo puesto

Programador Web PHP (laravel)

- Desarrollar y mantener las aplicaciones existentes y nuevas.
- Aplicar estándares de diseño, codificación y documentación
- Aportar la documentación técnica de las aplicaciones desarrolladas
- Trabajo en equipo aplicando las mejores prácticas y nuevas tecnologías
- Desarrollar pruebas unitarias, funcionales, de integración y E2E
- Estar involucrado durante todo el ciclo de vida de las aplicaciones

Qué necesitarás para encajar con el puesto

- Profesional con capacidad resolutiva, orientación de servicio al cliente, proactividad, espíritu de equipo y dinamismo.
- Formación académica de ciclo formativo de grado superior en Informática
- Experiencia laboral demostrable como desarrollador/a Backend (mínimo 2 años).
- Conocimientos en los principios de... la programación orientada a objetos
- Experiencia con PHP7 (framework Laravel)
- Experiencia creando APIs REST
- Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (MySQL)
- Conocimiento de GIT
- Se valorará conocimientos con sistemas de colas y en la gestión de servidores

Qué obtendrás a cambio

- Contrato indefinido directo con el cliente final
- Salario hasta 35.000 euros brutos anuales
- Incorporación en sólida Compañía multinacional en proceso de expansión.
- Ambiente de trabajo dinámico.
- Formación continua y posibilidades de desarrollo profesional.
- 3 días de teletrabajo a la semana
- Ubicación Esplugues, Barcelona
- Horario flexible para entrar
- Retribución flexible

Tu siguiente paso

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for Senior PHP Developer

Responsibilities
• Creation, development and maintenance of advanced web applications in PHP language
• Design and implementation of back-end solutions, including integration with databases, external services and other system components
• Optimising and monitoring application performance and troubleshooting application issues
• Collaborate with the development team, architects and other stakeholders to understand business and technical requirements and deliver the highest quality solutions
• Ensuring high quality code, adhering to best programming practices and ensuring security compliance

Requirements
• Minimum 4 years of experience in PHP programming and web application development
• Knowledge of advanced PHP technologies such as Laravel, Symfony, or Zend Framework
• Experience working with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
• Knowledge of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and frameworks such as Vue.js or... React
• Knowledge of version control tools such as Git
• Ability to troubleshoot, analyse code and optimise performance
• Good knowledge of spoken and written English

We Offer
• Type of contract B2B
• Full-time job
• Remote and flexible working hours

jobs_results.title: PHP Developer SR/Lead
jobs_results.description:
Quiénes somos:

Solera es líder mundial en servicios de datos y software que se esfuerza por transformar cada punto de contacto del ciclo de vida del vehículo en una experiencia digital conectada. Además, proporcionamos productos y servicios para proteger los otros activos más importantes de la vida: nuestros hogares e identidades digitales. En la actualidad, Solera procesa más de 300 millones de transacciones digitales al año para aproximadamente 235.000 socios y clientes en más de 90 países. Los 6.500 miembros de nuestro equipo fomentan una cultura innovadora fuera de lo común y se dedican a llevar con éxito el futuro al presente a través de respuestas cognitivas, perspectivas, algoritmos y automatización.

El puesto es 100% presencial en Alcobendas, Madrid / España

Experiencia de 6+ en desarrollo de software usando PHP

El candidato ideal escribirá PHP de forma eficiente y rápida de manera oportuna y escalable con el fin de mejorar la base de código de los productos de la empresa... de manera significativa. Este candidato será capaz de probar el código y hacer ajustes cuando sea necesario. También deberá tener experiencia en contribuir a todo el ciclo de vida del diseño de software.

Cualificaciones:
• Licenciatura en informática o campo relacionado
• Nivel avanzado de inglés (C1) como mínimo intermedio alto (B2)
• Experiencia en desarrollo de software
• Pasión por las mejores prácticas de diseño y codificación
• Conocimientos sólidos de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales
• Experiencia de 6+ en desarrollo de software usando PHP
• Pasión por las mejores prácticas de diseño y codificación
• Frameworks PHP (Laravel y Symfony)
• Desarrollo y consumo de APIs
• Pruebas unitarias
• Contenedores (Dockers y Kubernetes)

Beneficios:
• Seguro médico y de vida
• Plan dental y de visión
• 27 días laborables de vacaciones
• Bonificación anual

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Backend Developer II
jobs_results.description:
What is Exoticca?

Do you like traveling? Do you enjoy the exotic? Do you like challenges? If the answer is YES, welcome to Exoticca!

Exoticca is a company that started in 2013 by professionals specialized in the creation and online distribution of trips. Our mission is to offer our clients the possibility to visit the most beautiful and stimulating places on our planet, though the best holiday packages, at unbelievable prices. We are a highly ambitious and well-funded start-up, backed by top national and international investors that have also participated in the growth of other success stories, such as Glovo, SinDelantal.com, or Idealista, among others.

At Exoticca we are looking for people who want to offer their best to create unforgettable experiences for our customers. We are a young, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

What are we proposing?

We... are looking for tech-heroes with the desire to contribute to our mission, who admire different world cultures and have huge respect for the environment, who moreover feel energized with challenges and love being part of our company growth.

As a PHP Developer, you will be using mainly PHP and symfony and its related technologies to design, develop and implement projects derived from the challenges that we take on.

Your new and fresh ideas will always be welcomed to build the software that makes our vision a scalable reality.

Responsibilities
• Take responsibility for designing, developing, and implementing projects based on technological solutions to address the challenges we encounter
• Collaborate on migrating non-scalable and untestable code to best practices
• Be accountable for building, maintaining, and scaling infrastructure for both production and development environments
• Collaborate closely with the development team to comprehend automation requirements

Requirements
• Possess 3+ years of experience with PHP 7+ and Symfony 4+
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and SOLID principles
• Exhibit solid knowledge of hexagonal architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
• Experience in working with unit testing, TDD and ATDD
• Experience in working with event-driven architecture and event sourcing
• Be familiar with legacy PHP applications and their refactoring
• Demonstrate proficiency in designing REST APIs
• Be an excellent team player
• Have experience mentoring and guiding junior developers
• Possess leadership qualities for making technical decisions
• Pay meticulous attention to code quality, security, and performance
• Exhibit strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration and documentation

Nice to have:
• Willingness to learn Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and Elasticsearch
• A desire to advance within the company and take on leadership roles
• Knowledge of DevOps and infrastructure

Benefits
• Competitive compensation package, in line with job responsibilities and experience
• Individual Training Budget
• Flexible compensation on transportation and food with Cobee also in our private health insurance
• Flexible working schedule, just make sure you meet your monthly goals!
• 100% Remote working (from Spain)
• Permanent contract from the start
• Travel with Exoticca at reduced prices !!!
• Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you can earn a very nice bonus!
• And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization where teamwork, drive, commitment, resilience and being customer-centric are the core values

Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law

jobs_results.title: Programador/a php
jobs_results.description:
Desde Hays seleccionamos un perfil como Programador/a PHP para una Institución Educativa en Barcelona.

La persona seleccionada formará parte del área de Dirección de Investigación e Innovación y la principal misión será garantizar la usabilidad de las aplicaciones que se han desarrollado previamente, cumpliendo con los requisitos exigidos dentro de los proyectos derivados, además de realizar las siguientes funciones:

- Implementar las aplicaciones web y poder aplicarla a todos los formatos, idiomas y entornos necesarios en los proyectos.
- Diseño draft e implementación de interfaces digitales para aplicaciones desktop y en dispositivos móviles como desarrolladora.
- Actualización del material web de los proyectos de investigación, mantenimiento de aplicaciones y entornos web y Arclass.
- Análisis e investigación de estado del arte para el uso de módulos y gestión de los datos de los proyectos.
- Análisis de usabilidad de las aplicaciones y de las webs implementadas para los... proyectos de investigación.
- Concreción de aplicación de las tecnologías (lenguajes): HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP y trabaja con frameworks como CodeIgniter y Symfony aplicando metodologías Agile UX.

Para ello, seleccionamos a un perfil como Programador/Developer/Desarrollador de web, con al menos 1 año de experiencia en las mismas funciones dentro de agencia o empresa, formación universitaria en Diseño Gráfico, Multimedia o similar, Conocimiento avanzado de Indesign, Illustrator, Photoshop., conocimiento medio / alto de Figma o similares., conocimiento básico de edición de video (Premiere, After Effects) y Catalán y/o Castellano hablado y escrito y Anglès nivel intermedio.

Ofrecemos un contrato temporal para cubrir una baja de maternidad de larga duración (hasta diciembre 2023 aprox) jornada de 30h semanales, en franja horaria de mañanas, modalidad de trabajo en oficina y salario de 19.800€ brutos/año (para las 30h/semana).

Si te interesa la oferta, ¡no dudes en aplicar

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are GiG Media, one of the fastest-growing iGaming affiliate companies in Europe. GiG Media focuses on online promotion of iGaming (casino and sports betting) in the form of affiliate marketing, both paid and SEO.

We are currently looking for a super star Senior PHP Developer to join our winning team. The Senior PHP Developer's main responsibility is managing back-end services and the interchange of data between the server and the users. The primary focus will be the development of all server-side logic, definition, and maintenance of the central database, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front-end. This will require backend work on APIs, together with assisting designers with the frontend development on CMSs.

If you believe that this person could be you, let's have a chat!

IMPORTANT: in order to be considered for this opportunity, please submit your updated CV in English.

Requirements

Job duties and responsibilities:
• Work alongside other... developers and designers and with other team members
• Discuss work and requirements through JIRA
• Assign tasks to freelancers and monitor quality of code, while fulfilling the tasks to a high standard
• Understand business requirements and convert them to a solution design
• Code the design together with other developers from the team
• Do code reviews and ensure high standard of code quality
• Work on revising and developing data-crunching algorithms
• Deploy your code to live environments

What we are looking for:
• You probably have a degree in Computer Science, or skills and experience to match
• You have been working in web development for 3+ years and have experience with server-side and client-side application development
• Excellent command and experience using Symfony 3.4 + and PHP
• Experience with working with relation databases & NoSQL database
• Advanced knowledge of REST API architectures
• HTML / CSS / JavaScript will be considered as an advantage
• Experience with Git and/or other SCM system; solid knowledge of GitHub
• Familiar with JIRA or other project management and task system
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Familiar with working in Agile teams

Benefits

What we offer:
• Hybrid work model, with flexible working hours
• Birthday leave - it's your special day, so you can choose how and when to celebrate it!
• Volunteer day - one extra paid day so you can give back to the community
• 'Me Day' - a full paid day for you to take care of yourself and your mental health
• Private Health Insurance, with good network and coverage
• Daily lunches ordered at the office (different choices, including vegan option)
• An annual wellbeing benefit of 350 EUR
• Gym membership, including online fitness training classes
• Office events and parties
• Career progression opportunities - we will support your growth and help you to develop, for real!
• Salary review every year

• Work on revising and developing data-crunching algorithms
• Deploy your code to live environments

What we are looking for:
• You probably have a degree in Computer Science, or skills and experience to match
• You have been working in web development for 3+ years and have experience with server-side and client-side application development
• Excellent command and experience using Symfony 3.4 + and PHP
• Experience with working with relation databases & NoSQL database
• Advanced knowledge of REST API architectures
• HTML / CSS / JavaScript will be considered as an advantage
• Experience with Git and/or other SCM system; solid knowledge of GitHub
• Familiar with JIRA or other project management and task system
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Familiar with working in Agile teams

Benefits

What we offer:
• Hybrid work model, with flexible working hours
• Birthday leave - it's your special day, so you can choose how and when to celebrate it!
• Volunteer day - one extra paid day so you can give back to the community
• 'Me Day' - a full paid day for you to take care of yourself and your mental health
• Private Health Insurance, with good network and coverage
• Daily lunches ordered at the office (different choices, including vegan option)
• An annual wellbeing benefit of 350 EUR
• Gym membership, including online fitness training classes
• Office events and parties
• Career progression opportunities - we will support your growth and help you to develop, for real!
• Salary review every year

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer (PHP)
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for an experienced Backend Developer who wants to help us to build both our own startup-like products and extensive e-commerce and custom-made solutions with the main focus on Spryker and Magento e-commerce!

Who We Are

We are UFirstGroup, an international company based in Zurich and Valencia with more than 12 years of experience delivering highly performant, scalable and customized solutions for our international clients. With this experience and knowledge of the market, we are also currently building our own product already used by thousands of paying customers. UFirst people currently represent 6 nationalities from all over the world. Hence, the official company language is English in both our offices. We embrace self-organized teams, continuous delivery, trunk-based development and TDD. We also believe in open-mindedness and value every opinion when looking for the best-fitting solution. We are looking for you to join our team!

Tasks

How You Fit In With... Us

Together with your team, you are responsible for creating value for our customers and/or actively shaping our own product. You love to work effectively in collaboration with the team and actively contribute to problem solving and the realization of goals. Your team is working in a self-organized way.

You reflect on your work and the work of your colleagues. You look for ways to improve team performance and implement the measures defined in the team. You attach great importance to transparent communication and are happy to accept suggestions for improvement from your colleagues. You value personal interaction with your team colleagues and actively contribute to this. You value a culture of mistakes just as much as we do.

Requirements

We expect you to have:
• Minimum 3 years of experience in developing web apps
• Skills in PHP, preferably Spryker, Magento and Symfony
• Strong DB knowledge, at least one relational and/or no-SQL database
• Strong experience with effective integration of external services and data providers
• Experience in the analysis, design and implementation of complex projects and use this to identify and avoid possible problems in advance.
• Experience with docker (or other virtualization technologies)
• You always keep performance in mind and you understand basic web-security principles (CORS, proper sanitation, data security, …)
• Nice to have: Experience with Elixir or NodeJS

Last but not least:
• You are interested in current web technologies and open to new things
• You convince your colleagues with your current knowledge in the development of web applications
• You have a strong ability to learn new topics
• You enjoy effectively implementing what you have learned
• You convince your team to want to work with you
• You are a human and you like human beings

Core BE tech stack
• PHP, Spryker, Magento, Symfony
• psql, mariaDB, Elastic, Redis, ...
• Docker
• Elixir
• NodeJS

Other Technologies In Our Stack
• React, GraphQL, TypeScript, ReactNative
• Cypress.io
• Strapi_io
• Gitlab CI/CD, k8s, GCP, ArgoCD, AWS

Benefits

What we offer

A modern company culture and a great office in the Russafa neighborhood in Valencia. The opportunity to actively participate in shaping your work environment as well as work remotely. Interesting and challenging projects await you! You will also get
• Dedicated learning time to help you develop your skills
• Flexible working hours (option to work from home)
• Fair and objectively calculated compensation based on our salary formula
• You will travel to Zurich at least once a year
• MacBook
• External display and accessories, also for home-office
• AirPods 3 or alternative headphones
• iPhone or Android test devices needed for project development
• Regular events and on/off-site team buildings to cultivate UFG spirit

Procedure

Would you like to get to know us? We look forward to receiving your documents (including salary expectations)! If there is mutual interest, we will plan a first meeting via web conference. In the next step, we will send you a task that you have to solve within approx. 10 days. The result will then be reviewed and evaluated by your future team. In the second interview we talk about you, your plans and ideas as well as the submitted work. We will introduce you to our team and you will have the opportunity to talk to two of the four owners of the UFirst Group.
• Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
• Experience: Software Engineering: minimum 3 years
• Salary: 25,000.00€ - 45’000€ per year
• Location: 46005 Valencia, Valencia provincia
• Language: English (required)
• Work Remotely: Temporarily due to COVID-19, hybrid in the future

Headhunters

Dear Headhunters, we work with selected local partners and we do not intend to change them. Thank you for understanding and respecting our working hours
